description: This file defines a partial localization object containing Indonesian translations for a chat application. It includes various UI labels, prompts, error messages, and configuration options, structured as key-value pairs and functions for dynamic content.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates an input hint string based on the submit key, indicating how to send messages and available commands.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Displays the application version in settings.

methods.name: IsLatest
methods.description: Indicates whether the current version is the latest.

methods.name: FoundUpdate
methods.description: Shows the latest available version when an update is found.

methods.name: CheckUpdate
methods.description: Initiates a check for software updates.

methods.name: IsChecking
methods.description: Indicates if the app is currently checking for updates.
